classification.difficultyReason: Read the marked points from unit grids despite the surrounding picture outlines, preserving coordinate order and recognising points on axes and at the origin.

content.prompt: Write down the coordinates of the points labelled $A$ to $G$ in each diagram.

spec.description: Cartesian grid with supplied animal outline, seven labelled red coordinate points. Non-integer decorative outline vertices are traced from the source and require final-size comparison.
spec.mathematics: Grid step 1; bounds −5 to 5 on each axis; numeric labels −4 to 4 and 0. A(3,2), B(4,0), C(3,−3), D(−1,−1), E(−3,4), F(−2,3), G(0,2).
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied figure remains visible; coordinate answers are hidden in the question edition.

answer.worked:
Read the horizontal coordinate first, then the vertical coordinate, measuring from the origin.

$A$: 3 right, 2 up gives $(3,2)$.

$B$: 4 right, on the horizontal axis gives $(4,0)$.

$C$: 3 right, 3 down gives $(3,-3)$.

$D$: 1 left, 1 down gives $(-1,-1)$.

$E$: 3 left, 4 up gives $(-3,4)$.

$F$: 2 left, 3 up gives $(-2,3)$.

$G$: on the vertical axis, 2 up gives $(0,2)$.

answer.worked:
Read the horizontal coordinate first, then the vertical coordinate, measuring from the origin.

$A$: 1 right, 2 up gives $(1,2)$.

$B$: 3 right, 3 up gives $(3,3)$.

$C$: 3 right, 1 down gives $(3,-1)$.

$D$: 2 right, 1 down gives $(2,-1)$.

$E$: at the origin gives $(0,0)$.

$F$: 3 left, on the horizontal axis gives $(-3,0)$.

$G$: 2 left, 3 up gives $(-2,3)$.
